title: Four supermoons in a row
description:
The next supermoon rises on December 23. It is the Cold Moon. Four full Moons in a row come near perigee, the Moon’s closest point, and the first rose on Nov 24.
Credit: NASA picture: MSFC, MAF_20240819_SuperBlueMoon01. A different supermoon, over Alabama in 2024.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Marcella Pace: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-27-the-moon-watchers/. To use it, please ask the owner.
